name: Forensic imaging
steps: Acquire physical disk image (RAW/DD or E01) via write-blocked hardware or verified software write-block.
Record drive model, serial, size, partition layout before imaging.
Compute SHA-256 on source and image; verify independently.
Store images on authenticated media; label with case number, exhibit number, date, initials.
Verify image integrity with the original hash before analysis begins.
notes: Use E01 for compression+hash metadata; retain the raw hash for court.
